Name: Myc's Seasonal Fireplace for CP and AT
Author: Mycenia
Description:
I've had this sitting around for years now and finally decided it needed a new home. Nothing fancy, just a light stone fireplace with kettle and cauldron and some simple seasonal décor.

Content Patcher version replaces the stone fireplace (fireplace2) by default, but can be configured to replace any and all of them. There is also a static version with just the cauldron and kettle for those that want a simpler option.

*NEW* Alternative Textures pack. Has new, rather eclectic, option. Season variants for Stone and Brick Fireplace. Plain options for Stone, Brick, and Elegant.  

I'm still catching up to all the changes in 1.6, so let me know if anything is amiss. 




Thanks to Kimberly for letting me use some assets from her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1375]Witch Kitchen[/url] interior. Colors for flowers were pulled from eemie's lovely mods.
